name: jev-system-one
purpose: Typed advisory classification, scoring, routing and closed-choice decisions.

reference_plugin.note: Community Hermes plugin; it is not an MCP server and is not installed by this manifest.

output_schema.abstain_rule: confidence < 0.6 -> human queue (model ignores explicit abstain options)

guardrails: Validate the output schema before use.
Route low-confidence or abstain results to a human.
Public text only by default; email/CRM/ERP go to local classifier unless explicitly approved.
Do not transmit confidential or personal data to a third-party classifier.
Do not let the classifier execute external actions directly.
